name: clang+llvm
runtime_notes: Prebuilt Release libraries built with the STATIC MSVC CRT (/MT; linker metadata RuntimeLibrary=MT_StaticRelease) without RTTI or assertions. Consumers compile with /MT and /GR- in every configuration (so _ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL=0 always holds; the Debug configuration links too, with own code unoptimized and no debug CRT) and must not mix in /MD objects. LLVMDebugInfoPDB's export bakes the build machine's 'VS 2022 Enterprise\DIA SDK' path; cmake/ClangSdk.cmake remaps it to the local VS instance. LLVMWindowsManifest requires LibXml2::LibXml2, which is not shipped; it is not needed by clangTooling.
